name: research-plots
description: House style for every data figure: white background, black text, thick black frame and lines, large fonts, a few colour-blind-safe Okabe-Ito colours that keep one meaning across a project, labels next to the data instead of legends, real data only, and PDF plus 600 dpi PNG at final print size. Ships a matplotlib style module and a checker for finished figures. Use when making, restyling, fixing or reviewing any plot, chart or figure, in matplotlib, pgfplots, plotly or PowerPoint, for a paper, slides, a poster or a report.
